description: Eight gate channels, each able to be muted or logically inverted, with a jack beside every mute and invert button

params.text: Toggles that channel's mute, shown by the lamp; a muted channel outputs 0V
Toggles that channel's inversion, so 0V becomes 10V and a high gate becomes 0V; a muted channel stays at 0V

inputs.text: The gate for that channel, counted as high at 1V or more
A rising gate here toggles that channel's mute, as its button does
A rising gate here toggles that channel's inversion, as its button does
Feeds the eight channel gates from one polyphonic cable, channel 1 as gate 1; a numbered jack going high raises that gate too
A rising gate on one channel of the cable here toggles the matching channel's mute
A rising gate on one channel of the cable here toggles the matching channel's inversion

outputs.text: That channel's gate after muting and inversion, 10V or 0V
All eight output gates on one polyphonic cable, channel 1 as gate 1
